title.zh: Voice AI in vogue: Nvidia releases new open transcription model
title.en: Voice AI in vogue: Nvidia releases new open transcription model

current_state.zh: Nvidia released a free open speech-to-text model covering up to 40 languages that works on recorded audio but not live streams, targeting meeting and medical transcription use cases while leaving real-time transcription to rivals like ElevenLabs.
